trigger_and_stop_contract.trigger: Cycle 1 must have a terminal RESEARCH_GO, all integrity gates must pass, and a future execution authorization must pin the exact Cycle-1 result and manifest hashes before any materialization or fit.
ineligible_if: Cycle 1 has a hash, chronology, key, or leakage failure
Cycle 1 result or manifest hashes are unavailable
trigger_and_stop_contract.terminal_policy: After one authorized execution, stop P1 research regardless of pass or fail. A pass is only a local submission-worthiness finding; candidate creation and submission remain separate explicit actions.

hypothesis: The long-event segment structure has genuine incremental value, rather than merely receiving less tuning than the mature incumbent, if it retains a transport-sized F1 advantage after the incumbent and challenger receive the same sealed search cells, seeds, historical selection windows, outer folds, compute ceiling, metric, and stopping rules.

predecessor_contracts.sha256_policy: Re-verify this exact design SHA-256 in the future execution authorization; no design field may be edited to match results.

data_features_target_firewall.allowed_data: Historical labeled P1 training rows and frozen local prediction keys only, after a future authorization pins their existing hashes.
data_features_target_firewall.control_features: The exact qualifying anchor feature set plus neutral zero values and support=0 for every challenger-only segment channel.
data_features_target_firewall.challenger_features: The same ordered feature slots, with Cycle-1 long-event proposal, boundary, context, support, and segment-score channels populated exactly as locked by Cycle 1.
data_features_target_firewall.target: binary P1 label; the segment target and anchor-preserving rescue rule are byte-for-byte the Cycle-1 contract

leakage_safe_splits.inner_selection_windows: Byte-identical three chronological inner windows in P1 Cycle 1.
leakage_safe_splits.outer_locked_windows: Byte-identical 2025_q2, 2025_q3, and 2025_q4 ordered validation keys in P1 Cycle 1.
leakage_safe_splits.purge_and_prefix_rule: Byte-identical Cycle-1 strict training prefix with at least seven full days between fit end and validation start.
leakage_safe_splits.selection_rule: Each arm independently selects one finalist using inner windows only, including its frozen no-retune baseline as cell zero. The two selected finalists are then scored exactly once on the locked outer windows.

sealed_matched_search.finalist_selection: Maximize equal-weight mean inner-window F1 subject to all Cycle-1 safety gates that are evaluable on inner windows; ties resolve by higher worst-window delta, then lower total tree count, then lexical cell id.

fair_incumbent_control.control_arm: Qualifying frozen anchor structure with challenger-only slots neutralized.
fair_incumbent_control.challenger_arm: Cycle-1 qualifying segment structure with the same ordered slots populated.
fair_incumbent_control.control_finalist: Inner-selected best of frozen anchor cell zero and the eight retuned control cells.
fair_incumbent_control.challenger_finalist: Inner-selected best of frozen Cycle-1 challenger cell zero and the eight retuned challenger cells.
fair_incumbent_control.outer_comparison: selected challenger finalist minus selected control finalist

paired_bootstrap.unit: positive connected event or normal station-layer KST day

secondary_metrics: offset, drift, and at-least-48-hour event recall
false positives per station-layer KST day

SUBMISSION_GO.note: Research-only decision label; no candidate or official action is authorized.

P3_deprioritization.reason: The observed P3 headroom is too small to supply the requested 2-3 points. P1 matched-budget validation therefore receives priority while the separately frozen P3 ERA5 experiment is not touched.

limitations: The fixed eight-cell search may not reproduce the full historical tuning depth of every incumbent lineage, but it is exactly matched between arms.
There is no fresh untouched P1 labeled holdout; outer results remain a historical transport proxy.
Inner selection can favor a historical regime that differs from the official hidden regime.
The inferred point mapping is approximate and cannot guarantee leaderboard gain.
This final cycle terminates the P1 research branch regardless of outcome.
